hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance vaults that handles swap execution entirely in beforeSwap: it deposits input tokens into an Euler vault and withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, enforcing a custom price curve invariant. It intentionally reverts on liquidity additions, donations, and external pool initialization to prevent misuse of the hook address.
